name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Digital Marketing Manager · Multi-Channel Strategy, SEO & Analytics
summary: Marketing operations leader with 15+ years owning digital marketing end to end, paid search, SEO, email and lifecycle marketing, website and CMS management, and analytics-driven reporting, for lean, fast-moving organizations. Founder of Solenzo, where I run every digital channel for a portfolio of service-based clients and direct outside vendors and agencies rather than only executing. Comfortable as the single owner of a brand's full digital presence, from campaign strategy through KPI reporting.

experience.title: Founder & Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Own end-to-end digital marketing, paid search, SEO, email and lifecycle marketing, and analytics, for a portfolio of service-based business clients, running each channel from strategy through execution.
Optimize client Google Ads (paid search) accounts, cutting spam and low-quality leads and improving click-through quality, then diagnosing on-site conversion issues as the next lever.
Conduct technical SEO audits, keyword and competitor research, and implement fixes directly inside client CMS platforms, keeping website content aligned with brand positioning and search performance.
Architect CRM and marketing-automation systems in GoHighLevel and HubSpot, building 20+ lifecycle workflows spanning lead capture, appointment booking and reminders, nurture, and reactivation.
Track acquisition, engagement, and conversion in GA4 and CRM analytics, building ROI and KPI reporting shared directly with business owners to guide ongoing optimization.
Draft direct-response copy, landing pages, and campaign content that promotes offerings and drives engagement, plus recurring thought-leadership and newsletter content.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Managed integrated digital marketing strategies across paid media, inbound, and content, coordinating execution across internal teams, outside contributors, and agencies.
Built campaign performance reporting frameworks tracking ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion KPIs, translating results into optimization recommendations for stakeholders.
Produced high-converting landing pages, email sequences, and campaign copy that improved engagement and pipeline.
Ran keyword research and search-term analysis to shape campaign targeting and content direction.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Onboarded and managed 15–20 partner accounts, driving adoption of marketing-automation and reputation-management software and retaining all but one (~94%).
Developed automated communication and training workflows that reduced onboarding friction across a distributed partner network.
Collaborated cross-functionally with Product and Marketing to keep messaging and rollout consistent across partners.

bullets: Ran client accounts end to end at a performance marketing agency, covering campaign execution, performance reporting, and cross-team communication.
Analyzed paid media and creative performance and translated results into optimization recommendations.
Closed 6 new-client deals averaging ~$22K each (~$130K+ in total bookings) over tenure.

Onboarded and launched 25+ clients per month, holding 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets.
Directly managed a team of onboarding specialists, overseeing budgets, scope, and delivery across a high-value, multi-vertical client portfolio.
